author: Bobby Grayson
description: The tolerant reader split the 27 lines where two JSON objects had been glued together by concurrent appends. The old 'events rebuild' had failed on the first such line. 6 edges pointed at deleted nodes and were skipped.
title: Real corrupted JSONL log imported cleanly: 620 lines -> 831 events, 397 node + 163 edge records, 0 errors
